card.name: Words just before a positive noun or verb
card.fires_on: Scattered words in ordinary web prose where a positive or helpful object is about to follow, such as reader, can, sincere, visitors, the. No single word type is shared.

modes.label: Subject or object before a verb phrase
modes.description: A noun like reader or visitors that is followed by a verb of offering or leading.
modes.example: taking the<< reader>> through the Norse sagas, the first

modes.label: Small linking words before praise
modes.description: A helper word or article that comes just before a positive abstract noun, such as thanks, recognition or establishment.
modes.example: “for<< the>> cordiality and sympathy” they showed

modes.label: Modifiers in positive lists
modes.description: An adjective or comma inside a list of admired qualities.
modes.example: the most exciting,<< visually>> stunning, and timely coverage

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are forms of connect, so it mainly lowers the chance of the word connect coming next.
card.plain: It fires on many ordinary words in upbeat prose and mostly acts to make the word connect less likely next.
